fusions.name: Pinning Throw
fusions.desc: A hurled blow that deals 16 damage, up to 2.4 times as much at its maximum range of 10 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hail of Points
fusions.desc: Looses 4 bolts in a spread, each dealing 7 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: Increases your reach by 50% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Piercing Charge
fusions.desc: Your physical damage ignores 20% of armour.
